conclusion: Native hotjoin includes a compressed save-style transfer, receiver stream writes, completion notification, deferred shared mode-one load and guarded turn-request continuation. A new save-stream transfer feature is not required to explain this native recovery path. Static evidence does not establish successful disconnected-player rejoin, a complete admission protocol, or any particular observed failure cause. Title-specific restore policy and SDK reachability require their own source/runtime evidence.
